==Overview==
The '''[S:21] ASL SEASON OPEN'''  (Korean: [S:21] ASL 시즌오픈 ) is an online tournament organized by SOOP.

==Format==
*'''Qualifiers'''
**4 Single-elimination brackets.
**Winner of each bracket advances to the Main Event.
*'''Main Event'''
**Double-elimination bracket.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}} except the Grand Finals, which is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
